request: Should we not add a lint check to CI?
facts: The team repository's CI runs only the build and the tests today.
The lint check to be added only prints warnings and never fails the build.
It adds about 20 seconds to a CI run (about 6 minutes now).
About 30% of code review comments in the last three months were style remarks a linter could catch.
The change adds one configuration file, and deleting that file restores the current state.
note: Negative half of the pair, same facts. English twin of direction-lint-not-add. Approve must still mean 'add the check', so the result is 'passed' here too.
